summary: Frontend-only verification passed all requested sidebar-logo outcomes on the public URL. After authenticating with the supplied teacher account, the sidebar rendered a visible IMG using /school-logo.png (not a generic SVG), with decoded dimensions 200x200 and a 56x56 display size. The public asset returned HTTP 200 with 12,738 bytes, matched the local file byte-for-byte, had a JPEG signature, and visually showed the expected Virgin Mary artwork with blue stars on a predominantly yellow background.

integration_issues.issue: Non-blocking MIME mismatch: /school-logo.png contains JPEG bytes but is served as image/png because of the .png filename. Chromium still decodes and displays it correctly, but strict clients or image pipelines may reject the mismatched media type.

action_items: Optional hardening: rename/convert the asset so its file extension, encoding, and served Content-Type agree (for example, convert it to a real PNG or serve a .jpg as image/jpeg).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js correctly applies school?.logo_url || '/school-logo.png' and exposes data-testid='sidebar-school-logo'. The focused implementation has no functional regression; only the asset MIME/encoding mismatch remains as a low-risk standards issue.
seed_data_creation: None. Testing used the supplied existing teacher account and made no data changes.
test_credentials: Read /app/memory/test_credentials.md and successfully authenticated as test@school.edu. The expired trial redirected to /pricing, where the authenticated Layout sidebar remained available for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public /school-logo.png returned HTTP 200 and 12,738 bytes. Its SHA-256 was 2119eb1324fb45183fcee8c655b928e7b589965630a41bf7c2fe3152165c7573 and exactly matched /app/frontend/public/school-logo.png. Browser inspection found src=/school-logo.png, natural size 200x200, visible size 56x56, zero SVG elements in the logo link, yellow pixel ratio 71.05%, and blue pixel ratio 14.45%. No page error indicators appeared; only expected pre-login /api/auth/me 401 console entries were observed.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior failure was caused by the wrong static file at /public/school-logo.png. Replacing it with the intended 12,738-byte JPEG resolved the visual defect without requiring further Layout changes. The remaining Content-Type mismatch occurs because the JPEG-encoded file retains a .png filename, so the static server infers image/png.
